customMethods.script:
config = {}
	powerChart = self.getChild("PowerChart")

	# added a deepcopy utility that includes an option to convert Date to Instant format string
	config['config'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.config, True)
	config['axes'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.axes, True)
	config['pens'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.pens, True)
	config['plots'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.plots, True)
	config['title'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.title, True)
	config['timeAxis'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.timeAxis, True)
	config['interaction'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.interaction, True)
	config['dataColumns'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.dataColumns, True)
	config['legend'] = self.view.rootContainer.propertyDeepcopy(powerChart.props.legend, True)

	# this method easily converts the perspective property trees into json
	# using str() of the property itself can include various parts that are not json compatible
	if config:
		from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.common import TypeUtilities
		return str(TypeUtilities.pyToGson(config))
	return '{}'

customMethods.name: newDbTrendChart
customMethods.script:
# implement your method here
	TrendChartConfig = str(self.getConfigJson())
	TrendChartName = self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("SaveOptions").getChild("TrendName").props.text
	TrendChartIsPrivate = True
	UserID = self.session.props.auth.user.id
	
	# Administrator can create shared charts
	if 'Administrator' in self.session.props.auth.user.roles:
		TrendChartIsPrivate = self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("SaveOptions").getChild("PrivatePublic").props.value
		
	params = {"TrendChartName": TrendChartName, "TrendChartConfig": TrendChartConfig, "TrendChartIsPrivate": TrendChartIsPrivate, "UserID": UserID}
	TrendChartID = system.db.runNamedQuery("TrendCharts/NewCustomTrend", parameters = params, getKey=1)	
	return TrendChartID

customMethods.name: saveDbTrendChart
customMethods.script:
# location of 'confirm overwrite' popup
	OverwritePopupLocation = 'Library/History/Popup/overwrite_trend_chart'
	
	# parameters
	TrendChartName = str(self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("SaveOptions").getChild("TrendName").props.text)
	UserID = int(self.session.props.auth.user.id)
	TrendChartIsPrivate = True # Charts are private by default 
	
	# Administrator can save shared charts
#	if 'Administrator' in self.session.props.auth.user.roles:
	TrendChartIsPrivate = int(self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("SaveOptions").getChild("PrivatePublic").props.value)	
		
	# Check if name exist in DB
	params = {"TrendChartName": TrendChartName, "TrendChartIsPrivate": TrendChartIsPrivate, "UserID": UserID}
	TrendChartID = int(system.db.runNamedQuery("TrendCharts/CheckForCustomTrendName", params))
		
	# name already exists
	if TrendChartID != -1:
		if 'Administrator' in self.session.props.auth.user.roles:
			# Popup to ask for overwrite, confirmation will send 'TrendChartOverwriteConfirmed' message
			system.perspective.openPopup('TrendChartConfirmOverwrite', 
										OverwritePopupLocation, 
										params = {"TrendChartID": TrendChartID},
										title = "A trend chart with this name exists",
										modal = True)
		else:			
			system.perspective.sendMessage("alertMessage",{"text":"Trend already exists. Need admin rights to override.","bgColor":"--error","color":"--textAlternative"},scope="session")
	# name does not exist 								
	else: 
		# Insert new chart into DB	
		TrendChartID = self.newDbTrendChart()
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Table").refreshBinding("props.data")
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("SaveOptions").getChild("Table").refreshBinding("props.data")
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").custom.ShowSaveOptions = False	
		self.clearSaveOptions
		self.selectTrendChart(TrendChartID)
		
	if TrendChartIsPrivate == 1:
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Head").getChild("PrivatePublic").props.value = 1
	else:
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Head").getChild("PrivatePublic").props.value = 0
		
	self.clearTableSelection()

customMethods.name: selectTrendChart
customMethods.script:
# implement your method here
	TrendCharts = self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Table").props.data
	
	SelectedRow = -1
	TrendName = ""
	for row in range(TrendCharts.getRowCount()):
		if TrendCharts.getValueAt(row, "TrendChartID") == TrendChartID:
			SelectedRow = row
			TrendName = TrendCharts.getValueAt(row, "TrendChartName")
			
			
	if SelectedRow > -1:
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Table").props.selection.selectedColumn = "TrendChartName"
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Table").props.selection.selectedRow = SelectedRow
		self.getChild("FlexTrendSelector").getChild("MainTrendUI").getChild("Table").props.selection.data = [{"TrendChartName": TrendName}]
